scope: Gross on-demand planning rates. No credits, commitments, free tiers, tax or actual invoice equivalence assumed. Models and unresolved network SKUs are scenario assumptions.
caveats: Cloud SQL Enterprise general-purpose dedicated core, explicitly selected edition; HA rates already include redundancy. Additional replicas/extended support are excluded unless budgeted separately.
Cloud Run request billing, Mumbai Tier1. Billed instance time is estimated using effective concurrency and idle floors; actual metering/startup/tail overlap must replace assumptions.
Firestore Standard named database has no free quota. Count document/index/transaction/listener/retry work, not one read per API request.
CDN rates assume Asia-Pacific destination with in-region cache fill. Do not substitute for other destination/miss/private-origin paths.
Global ALB India processing and non-CDN internet egress are unresolved exact SKU assumptions. Do not charge the same API egress again under Cloud Run.
Identity Platform rates apply only if enabled; basic Firebase non-phone auth differs. SMS/SAML/OIDC require separate inputs.
Razorpay published standard successful-payment fee is2% plus applicable GST; actual merchant/subscription contract, refunds and exceptions require confirmation. Fee tax and FX are assumptions.
